Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: In the second step (the first Planner update after the initial WebSurfer search), the Planner incorrectly concluded that "multiple winners are tied for the most BBC Sports Personality of the Year awards (two wins), with Henry Cooper among them." This conclusion was based on a hallucination or misinterpretation of the search results, which clearly stated in the visible text: "Andy Murray holds the record for the most BBC Sports Personality of the Year wins, having won the award three times." The Planner failed to correctly read the search result provided by the WebSurfer, leading to an incorrect identification of the record holder (Henry Cooper instead of Andy Murray) and consequently an incorrect answer to the final question (George Cooper instead of Jamie Murray).
